_meta.title: Pipeline assemble (core video concat)
_meta.description: Final step of the Shorts Studio and Click to Ad pipelines, core ComfyUI + VideoHelperSuite only, no models. Template = one scene; the builder (src/lib/oj/pipelineAssemble.ts) keeps SaveVideo and regenerates the rest per scene: VHS_LoadVideo (resampled to the output fps, frame cap = clip length) -> ImageScale (center crop to 720x1280 or 1080x1920) -> optional last-frame hold (ImageFromBatch -1 -> RepeatImageBatch -> ImageBatch) so the shot lasts as long as its narration -> TextOverlay caption -> CreateVideo. Soundtrack: per scene LoadAudio narration padded with EmptyAudio and cut by TrimAudioDuration to the scene's exact length, chained with AudioConcat; the music bed (AudioAdjustVolume, TrimAudioDuration) is mixed in with AudioMerge. ConcatenateVideo joins the scenes with that soundtrack as complete_audio -> SaveVideo (H.264 MP4).
